vlog_arc.theme: Building in public means showing the week as it is, not as you wished it went.

beats.mon: Leo films his pre-dawn cup before training, camera on the kitchen counter, no ring light — 'This is what Monday actually looks like at 4:47am; the week starts here, not at the office.'
beats.tue: Standing outside the warehouse after a supplier call, Leo addresses one real operational friction that came up — 'The pipe broke today in a small way; I'm not going to pretend it didn't, here's how we're fixing it by Thursday.'
beats.wed: Leo holds up a printed customer review at his desk — 'This came in overnight; I want to read it to you exactly as she wrote it, because no copy I could write does what her words just did.'
beats.thu: Filming from a coffee shop mid-afternoon, Leo explains why he scheduled nothing creative today — 'Thursdays are for the work that nobody posts about; I cleared the backlog so Friday can actually move the brand forward.'
beats.fri: Leo films a short end-of-week walk outside — 'One thing worked better than expected, one thing didn't ship the way I planned; I'll tell you both, because that ratio is actually a good week.'
beats.sat: Kitchen table, Gabriel in the background doing homework — 'He asked me today what Power Coffee is for; I told him it's so people can show up fully, and he said that makes sense; that's the whole brief, actually.'
beats.sun: Leo films briefly after church, quiet and unhurried — 'Sunday is the only day I don't plan the brand; I think that's why Monday always starts with more clarity than Friday ended with — rest is part of the formula too.'
